components.description: One regular (Fall or Spring) semester of paid parental leave, granted on request, for the birth, adoption or legal guardianship of a child; 19.5 contiguous weeks for twelve-month employees, up to 3 months for non-instructional employees. Usable twice per career; one parent per event when both are UCF employees.
components.faculty_group_note: members of the UFF bargaining unit ("employee" means a member of the bargaining unit); Appendix A lists Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor
components.eligible_parent_wording: an employee becomes a biological parent, a child is placed for adoption in the employee’s home, or the employee becomes the legal guardian of a child; for the birth, adoption, or assumption of legal guardianship of a child
components.entitlement_note: 'shall be granted, upon request': the institution must grant it once requested (V2; schema 2c).
components.duration_note: Coded at one semester, the alternative for the academic-year (9-month) tenure-stream member (summary: 'Faculty on 9-month contracts may receive a semester of paid parental leave'). components.pay_fraction: full salary and fringe benefits (paid parental leave; the college pays salary and fringe benefits)
components.relief_note: 17.7(b) states no relief; formal leave (R9). The 2018_03 summary agrees: on full leave of absence a faculty member should not participate in any UCF teaching, research or service.
components.service_requirement: employed for a minimum of one academic year on at least a 0.75 FTE line; not for temporary, term-limited or visiting appointments; soft-money employees only as the grant permits

components.notice: written request no later than three months prior to the anticipated beginning of the leave; shorter notice at the provost's discretion for good cause
components.return_obligation: must agree in writing to return to University employment for at least one academic year; repayment of salary, retirement, benefits and expenses if the terms are not met; hours used are deducted from the sick/annual leave balance remaining at separation (17.7(b)(7))
components.use_limit_note: Parental leave may be used no more than twice during the employee’s employment at the University (17.7(b)(1)).

notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Governing document: the 2015-2018 UCF BOT-UFF agreement as supplemented (2018_00); Art. 17 Leaves was ratified December 8, 2015 and is unchanged by the 2016 and 2018 supplements (Arts. 3, 8, 23, 24, 30). The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply: a collective agreement covering tenure-stream faculty is saved, so missing is false.

Compared with 2018_00, 2018_01 is the December 2015 base text: it differs in the reopened Arts. 3, 8, 23, 24, 30.1(d), in office names (Office of Faculty Relations) and in Appendix G (superseded 2014-15 Arts. 3 and 23); Arts. 15 and 17 read the same.

2018_02 (Faculty Handbook, 09/2015) holds no parental-leave provision; it describes sabbaticals, professional development leave, leave-of-absence requests and the Sick Leave Pool (c9), and the UCF Creative School child care (not a leave). 2018_03 is an undated Office of Faculty Excellence summary of the agreement's paid parental leave and modified instructional duties, used only for details the agreement leaves open (pay level, which semester, the 9-month case) and for one summary-only statement (c13).

Calendar: Art. 32 defines a semester as one of the two approximately 19.5-week periods that constitute the academic year (approximately 39 contiguous weeks), and 17.7(b)(1) sets 19.5 contiguous weeks for twelve-month employees in place of one semester; the 19.5-week semester is an appointment period, not a term (first class to last exam), so calendar.term_weeks is left empty: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. The instructional period is at most an average of 75 days per semester (9.3(b)).

Whom the figures describe (U8): an academic-year (9-month) tenure-stream member with two years of service: eligible for paid parental leave (one academic year on a 0.75 FTE line) and FMLA. Twelve-month employees: 19.5 contiguous weeks of paid leave; non-instructional employees: up to 3 months (c1 duration_variants).

Birth parent chain: paid parental leave, one semester (c1), with FMLA 12 weeks alongside from its start (c11); or instead (in_lieu_of) unpaid parental leave up to 6 months (c4) beginning up to two weeks before the birth, containing up to 6 (8 after a C-section) weeks of own paid sick leave from the birth (c5, within c4), FMLA alongside (c11); or instead a negotiated non-instructional semester in which the child is expected (c2), or instead an altered schedule (c3).

Non-birth parent chain: paid parental leave, one semester (c1), FMLA alongside (c11); or instead unpaid parental leave up to 6 months (c4), FMLA alongside; or instead the negotiated non-instructional semester (c2) or altered schedule (c3). When both parents are UCF employees only one may take c1 for an event.

Not coded as components: compulsory leave (17.8(c)), which the president imposes on an employee unable to perform duties (with or without pay, at most the duration of the illness or one year), because a parent does not request it; job-related illness/injury pay (17.8(b)); jury, military, disaster, athletic and investigation leaves (17.10); union-activity leave (3.3); sabbaticals and professional development leave (22); phased retirement (24.6).

Statutes: FMLA is relied on (17.1(e), 17.6, 17.7(b)(3), 17.8) and coded (c11), verified against 29 U.S.C. 2612 and 2611 in the saved statute texts. Florida has no statutory-baseline row and the sources name no Florida leave statute; the other statutes named are listed under C4 not_components.

Documents cited but not saved: In-unit Paid Parental Leave Memorandum of Understanding and Parental Leave Request form (17.7(b)(4); 2018_03); Modified Instructional Duties Application (2018_03); UCF Faculty Regulation 3.0261 Faculty and A&P Sick Leave Pool (2018_02); UCF Regulation 3.018 Conflict of Interest/Commitments/Outside Activity/Employment (2018_03); the University FMLA policies referred to in 17.6; the Medical or Parental Leave Request Form and UCF Medical Certification Form (17.7(c), 17.8); Leave and Attendance page (2018_02).
